steps.en: Point an MCP client at the PyPI entry point
steps.zh: 在 MCP 客户端里填上 PyPI 入口

steps.en: Starts FastMCP over stdio and registers the PowerPoint tools
steps.zh: 用 stdio 拉起 FastMCP，注册 PowerPoint 工具

steps.en: Ask the client to create a deck and add slides
steps.zh: 让客户端新建演示文稿并加幻灯片

steps.en: Holds a python-pptx Presentation in process memory and mutates it
steps.zh: 在进程内存里握着一份 python-pptx 演示文稿并改它

component.zh: 内存中的 presentations 字典

steps.en: Tell it where to write the file

value.en: An LLM client can build a .pptx through tool calls — you never write the python-pptx glue
value.zh: LLM 客户端用 tool 调用就能做出 .pptx，你不用写 python-pptx 胶水
